english.title: Other than in an emergency operate the stop switch / lever of an escalator / travolator within Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), within Heathrow Airport at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), otherwise than in the case of an emergency, intentionally operated a

(A)_[switch]_
(B)_[lever]_

of

(C)_[an escalator]_
(D)_[a travelator]_
(E)_[a tracked transit system]_
(F)_[a lift]_
(G)_[an automatic conveyance for passengers, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONVEYANCE..),]_

upon or near to which a sign was displayed stating that it was only to be operated in case of emergency
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3.3 and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
